findings.text: the undetermined case is merely guarded against named-window and Boolean-field regressions, not made unreachable as a verdict: the assertion scans verdict.values(), while the returned non-empty mapping itself is truthy; an independent single-stamp probe produced binding_window=undetermined, no Boolean values, and bool(verdict)=True, so a caller using if budget.binding_window(...) can still consume the undetermined result as a positive verdict.

the landing record is tagged data-section=_top even though the node contract requires the worker to append its record to its own plan section and the manifest says it appended the comment to section 5; section-scoped readers therefore cannot identify this record as section 5 evidence from its semantic binding.

the record commit changes plan-modified and plan-version from 2026-09-15 and 33 to 2026-09-21 and 34 despite the dispatch contract explicitly forbidding the worker from editing those meta lines; a server-authored change still lands in the worker diff and recreates the shared-plan conflict the fence was written to prevent.
